build_transformer_model: build a TransformerModel instance for encoder or decoder with configurable layers, heads, and embeddings
create_sinusoidal_embeddings: create sinusoidal position embeddings for a given sequence length and embedding dimension
generate_text_greedy: generate a target sentence using greedy decoding from a source encoding and target language ID
generate_text_beam_search: generate a target sentence using beam search decoding with configurable beam size and length penalty
test_multihead_attention: test MultiHeadAttention forward pass with self-attention and cross-attention over source sentence
